milestone: Native model row sources and backend caches bound to canonical Trellis request
status: qualified component; full model and original goal remain incomplete

ownership.model: Immutable row-source array bound by architecture tensor IDs after anatomy/numerics and before backend creation. Borrowed storage index remains model-owned.
ownership.backend_model: One owned CPU container holds independently bounded mutable table caches; freed before model row sources. Shared operations require caller serialization.
ownership.session: Row staging metadata embedded in existing TrellisRequest; request owns device buffers and pinned upload pool. Teardown destroys GPU request before metadata.
ownership.result: Canonical request, session identity, monotonic session request generation, per-bank epoch and exact resident view. Generation persists reset and rejects request-address reuse.

budget_scope: Cache host bound includes container plus per-table caps. Session row host/pinned/device budgets are additional component budgets, excluding allocator/context/index/source metadata and other native request components.
behavior: Atomic source publication and cache attachment; invalid setup does not publish partial state.
No live request geometry upgrade; matching setup is idempotent.
Busy preserves outputs without source/cache work. Storage/domain rejection preserves prior live results. Backend failure tears down the entire native request.
Raw row IDs only. No tokenizer/hash mapping, token history, KV or position commit.
not_claimed: Full Engram/PLE/HCA forward or CLI admission
Independent qualification of the required BF16 to F16 projection precision adapter
Combined attention producer plus row staging numerical execution
Prefill/decode vLLM parity, global serving admission, async storage or a new CUDA kernel
New ARM, Metal or WASM execution coverage

validation.qwen27: Strict independent llama.cpp sampled token IDs: 192/192, first token 8/8, count mismatches 0/8.
validation.sanitizer_scope: ASAN/UBSAN cover new C source/model/cache/session orchestration and probe; legacy moe_cpu_kernels.o and CUDA translation units are normal build. Real native request pipeline passed CUDA memcheck with full leak check and initcheck. Unchanged row kernel tested with bounded racecheck; no whole-core racecheck.
validation.reference: Unmodified original Triton-captured BF16 row values for real checkpoint layer 1 and layer 14; hashes checked before and after all qualification runs.
validation.fresh_trace: No fresh timing or whole-model performance qualification in this milestone; previous staging-controller trace remains separate evidence.
